## Loading Dataset & Libraries

Loading all libraries necessary:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

Loading csv and viewing

```{r}
exp_patient <- read_csv("../data/inpatient_patients_example.csv")

head(exp_patient)
```

```{r}
table(exp_patient$icd9)
table(exp_patient$icd10)
```
